motivation: Both retained three-graph runs show independent-live Actor timers approximately 11% above native. Diagnostic CPU sampling attributes only about 3-4% of current updateTimers samples directly to BuffRuntime.advance; the whole observed difference cannot be attributed to this loop.
candidate: Subtract clocks in place until the first expiry. If all survive, preserve scalar subtraction without finding a maximum or resetting array length. On expiry, include the already-updated prefix in the maximum and compact the untouched suffix in application order.
preserved: All existing reentry, finite-input, collection, nesting and callback guards.

Empty arrays expire. Complete expiry leaves detached stacks and remaining unchanged.
Partial expiry recomputes remaining across all survivors, including the prefix; updates stacks; and publishes once.

limits: Prefix maximum scanning adds a second visit to surviving prefix elements on partial expiry. Measure all existing expiry workloads, not only all-live clocks.
